lines.en: I never stop; I walk toward you.

lines.zh: 我推开门，门框晃了一下。
lines.en: I push a door open, and the frame shakes.

lines.zh: 我走过长走廊，速度不变。
lines.en: I cross the long hall at the same pace.

lines.zh: 我的脚落地很慢，但很稳。
lines.en: My feet land slowly, but surely.
I don't run; I simply don't stop.
I pass through brush, and branches snap.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向偏了一点。
lines.en: I angle a little toward you.
My shadow trails behind you.
I step across a ditch without slowing.
I go around the stone without detouring far.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草压平了。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass lies flat.
I came from far off and never stopped.
I stop, but only for now.
I stand there, head slightly low.

lines.zh: 我在看你的方向很久了。
lines.en: I've been facing your way a long while.
I remember you moved just now.
My body is long and my head hangs low.
I'm waiting for you to go further.
The air grows heavy near me.

lines.zh: 我头偏向一边，像在听土。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if listening to the floor.
My fingers hang, very long.
I have all the time in the world.
I let my hands hang, heavy.

lines.zh: 我听着房子里的每一种响动。
lines.en: I listen to every sound the house makes.
I'm facing you, and have been.
I lower my head; you look small.
Turn and run; I don't mind.
In the dark my eyes are on you.
Have you counted how far is left?
One step back from you, one forward from me.
Your hands shake; it doesn't surprise me.
I'm here, and you're there.
This distance will keep shrinking.
That door behind you is open.
I don't speak; speaking means nothing.

lines.zh: 你的脸我看不清，也不需要。
lines.en: I can't see your face, and needn't.

lines.zh: 你换了站姿，我注意到了。
lines.en: You shifted your stance; I noticed.
Your lamp sways; your hand isn't steady.
I stop and let you run first.
Your scent stays on the doorknob.
Only a few steps lie between us.
I tilt my head at your raised sword.
I sway once and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，很快抬头。
lines.en: I glance at the wound and look up fast.

lines.zh: 我的形状没变，只是凹了。
lines.en: My shape holds; it's only dented.
I don't cry out, and needn't.
I brace on the wall and steady.
You hit hard enough.
I shudder, then keep walking.

lines.zh: 伤口在我身上很快就不见了。
lines.en: The wound is gone from me quickly.
You stopped, so I quicken.
You look back; I don't hide.
That small light; I walk toward it.
Your breathing draws me.
Shut the door; I'll open it.
You back to the end; that's convenient.
I heard your voice.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我不在意。
lines.en: What's in your hand; I don't care.
I care only about distance.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我连退都没退。
lines.en: You crash in; I don't even give ground.
I didn't yield; you did.

lines.zh: 我的身体把你挤到一边。
lines.en: My body presses you aside.
We meet, and you hear a dull thud.
You push me; I don't move.

lines.zh: 我从你身边走过去，很慢。
lines.en: I walk past you, slowly.
My arm sweeps you.
I block you; you can't back out.

lines.zh: 我们分开时，你已经喘了。
lines.en: When we part, you're already panting.

lines.zh: 碰到我的人都会停一下。
lines.en: Anyone who touches me pauses.

lines.zh: 另一个也从走廊那头走来。
lines.en: Another walks from the far end of the hall.
We don't close; we walk the same way.
Our steps share a frequency.
She doesn't stop either.

lines.zh: 我们从两边走进同一个房间。
lines.en: We enter the same room from two sides.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上并成一条。
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one line.
She's a little faster; I keep up.
We don't speak, and needn't.
Together we block the door.
Only one; we'll share it.

lines.zh: 我拾起你的手电筒，捏灭了。
lines.en: I pick up your flashlight and crush it out.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的钥匙收进手里。
lines.en: I close my hand on your dropped key.

lines.zh: 我捡起挡路的椅子，放到一边。
lines.en: I pick up the chair in my way and set it aside.

lines.zh: 我拾起一张纸，看了一眼。
lines.en: I pick up a paper and glance at it.

lines.zh: 我把你的刀捡起来，折了。
lines.en: I pick up your knife and snap it.

lines.zh: 我抓起一截木头，扔远了。
lines.en: I grab a length of wood and throw it far.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚硬币，塞进缝里。
lines.en: I pick up a coin and push it into a crack.

lines.zh: 我把掉在地上的布盖回去。
lines.en: I put the fallen cloth back over it.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块石头，握着走。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and carry it.

lines.zh: 我把门闩拿起来，放在高处。
lines.en: I take the bolt and set it high.
I walk toward you; that's all.
You're over there; I see you.
I needn't choose; there's only you.
You heard my steps.
I'm coming to this building.
The door opened; I go in.
You're penned in the corridor.
Once I start, I don't stop.
Your position is certain.
I needn't be fast; speed is useless.
Turn around; save your strength.
I've chosen this door.
You're ahead of me; good.
I heard you turn off the light.
Ten more steps and I'm there.
Step by step, and nothing changes.
You circle behind the house; I circle too.
I take the door off its hinges.
However fast you run, you'll tire.
I hear you panting behind the wall.
My shadow is already at the door.

lines.zh: 我在这里停下，只是为了听。
lines.en: I pause only to listen.
You go upstairs; I take the stairs.
The stairs creak under me.
You don't know which floor I'm on.
I keep closing the distance.
The place you hide has a gap under the door.
I count the steps remaining.
You needn't run; I've arrived.
I walk into that room.
You're against the wall; I see you.

lines.zh: 我的长手已经举到门梁。
lines.en: My long arm is up at the door lintel.
I reach the stairwell without stopping.

lines.zh: 你在我前面跑，我听得见。
lines.en: You run ahead; I can hear you.
I stop in the doorway and block it.
I press a hand down, and you're pinned.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的肩，很重。
lines.en: My hand closes on your shoulder, heavy.

lines.zh: 我往前一推，你退了三步。
lines.en: I push forward, and you give three steps.

lines.zh: 我的指头扣住你的手腕。
lines.en: My fingers lock your wrist.
I raise the other hand and bring it down.

lines.zh: 这一下不快，但你没躲开。
lines.en: It wasn't fast, but you didn't dodge.
I press you into the corner.
You struggle once and don't break free.
I lower my head, very close.
I let go, and you back away again.

lines.zh: 我的手背扫过你的脸侧。
lines.en: The back of my hand sweeps your cheek.
I take your collar and hoist.

lines.zh: 你脚下打滑，我扶了一把。
lines.en: You slip; I catch you once.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的影子，你慢了。
lines.en: I step on your shadow, and you slow.

lines.zh: 这一下我甚至没用多少力。
lines.en: I barely used any strength there.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，你又靠近了。
lines.en: I stand still, and you come near again.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方开始走。
lines.en: I start walking from very far away.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里多了一个影子。
lines.en: One more shadow in this building.
I settle and look this way.

lines.zh: 门没有响，我已经进来了。
lines.en: The door made no sound; I'm inside.
The floor here barely holds me.
I lift a foot for the first time, slowly.
My head nearly touches the doorframe.
I begin to walk; that's all.

lines.zh: 我数了一下，只有一个人。
lines.en: I count: only one person.
I come around the corner of the wall.
The air goes suddenly quiet.
I walk toward your hand lamp.
I've come; no need to wait.
I push the door open, slowly.
All the doors on this floor are shut.
I stop, head slightly low.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，我照走不误。
lines.en: Fire burns on me; I walk regardless.

lines.zh: 水压住我，我的步子更沉。
lines.en: Water presses me; my steps grow heavier.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推远，我又走回来。
lines.en: The blast pushes me off; I walk back.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，我照旧走。
lines.en: Arrows stick in me; I keep walking.
A light holds me for an instant.
I don't eat; I only slow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我停了一拍。
lines.en: Lightning hits me; I miss one beat.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，还是朝你那个方向。
lines.en: I fall, still facing your way.
